status: Exploratory bounded local CPU diagnostic, no confirmatory or converged-generalization claim
question: Does the original score rank epoch-100 validation CE in the minimization direction compared with same-epoch validation CE, across eight configurations independently for two fresh initialization seeds?
declared_change_bundle: Relative to the prior five-epoch pilot, endpoint, cosine schedule horizon and initialization seeds all change. Do not attribute differences causally to endpoint alone. Within this panel, same-epoch comparisons are primary. Reported loss also uses stable reconstructed logit CE, correcting probability-clipping underestimation possible in the older pilot. It is an explicitly declared numerical-definition change, not an endpoint-only experiment.
dataset: Cached MNIST npz only, no downloads; access x_train and y_train arrays only; never load x_test or y_test
indices: Half-open intervals in official training partition
config_order: product(learning_rate, weight_decay), learning_rate outer loop, IDs0..7

architecture.note: Existing get_mnist_model, no architecture code changes

optimizer: Existing get_mnist_model Adam, cosine decay from each initial LR to zero over2400 steps
initialization: Reset keras.utils.set_random_seed(seed) for every candidate; exact initial weight hashes must agree within seed
shuffle: Independent numpy.default_rng(seed) for each candidate; identical permutation hashes within seed at every epoch

scores.original_rms_ratio_max: Original float32 model outputs and hidden activations: max across fixed ordered training batches64 (including last28) of RMS(p)*RMS(h)/RMS(W). Current candidate model only.
scores.relative_head_trace_centered: C1 from frozen normalization_protocol.json; full-training arithmetic mean_i[(1-sum_k p_ik^2) * sum_j h_ij^2 * sum_k W_c[j,k]^2]. No formula changes.
scores.temperature_curvature: C2 from frozen normalization_protocol.json; full-training arithmetic mean_i[sum_k p_ik*z_c,ik^2-(sum_k p_ik*z_c,ik)^2]. No formula changes.
scores.numeric_policy: C1/C2 recompute centered logits and stable softmax in float64 from frozen float32 model activations/kernel/bias; arithmetic means over all1500training examples. Do not clip, invert, smooth or normalize scores across checkpoints.
scores.scientific_scope: C1 and C2 are separately named controls with different meaning; neither repairs the original theorem or implies HPO success. Retain known limitations from normalization protocol.

epoch_logging: Training and validation CE are mean(logsumexp(z)-sum(y*z)) from float64 logits reconstructed from current model hidden activations/kernel/bias, without clipping predicted probabilities. Accuracy uses actual float32 model probabilities. Record maximum absolute probability reconstruction discrepancy for both splits and fail on discrepancy>1e-5. Retain each original-score batch, optimizer step/LR and shuffle hash.
primary_target: Per-candidate validation CE at exactly epoch100
secondary_target: Per-candidate minimum validation CE across all100 epochs, separately labelled validation-selected best-across100 target, repeated validation use and not unbiased test evidence
primary_analysis: For each seed separately and every epoch1..100: Spearman across all8 configurations, each score vs primary target, compared with same-epoch validation CE. All metrics minimized, no sign reversal. No p-values or pooled claim.
secondary_analysis: The same fixed correlations against the separately named secondary target. Do not substitute it for primary after inspection.

selection_regrets.direction: minimize every score and validation CE

learning_rate_analysis: For each seed/epoch/metric report LR-score and LR-target Spearman associations. Prespecified sensitivity collapses each LR pair to arithmetic mean score/target across bothWDs; four LR-level points, descriptive only. Within-LR n=2 cannot support correlation inference.
terminal_diagnostic: At epoch100 compute L2 norm of full-network gradient of mean training categorical CE over all1500 examples, inference mode, sample-weighted batch gradient accumulation in float64; exclude optimizer weight-decay term. Do not infer stationarity from schedule ending at0. Gradient uses TensorFlow logits-aware categorical CE on current model tensors (float32 autodiff), with no NumPy conversion before differentiating. Float64 reported CE and float32 gradient have the same un-clipped mathematical loss.

resources.cap_semantics: Check before each epoch. Active epoch and final checkpoint I/O may extend past bound. Stop without new epochs and mark entire panel INCOMPLETE. No paid compute.

integrity: All16 candidates required for correlations/regrets; otherwise no aggregate available-subset analysis. Preserve every epoch, failure, unstarted identity, complete and partial optimizer-bearing checkpoints, next shuffle RNG states. No exclusions or overwritten runs.
checkpoint_policy: Save epoch1 and epoch100 optimizer-bearing models for complete candidates; partial model and RNG state on timeout/failure. No implicit continuation.
revision_note: Whitespace-only source correction after copied-source no-sloppy check. All scientific definitions unchanged; all earlier unexecuted protocol drafts retained.
